skills.name: Charging Mode
skills.desc: Auto. When ready, the basic attack fires 3 shots (121% ATK each).

skills.name: Shooting Mode
skills.desc: For 2 turns, basic attacks fire 4 shots (110% ATK each).

skills.name: Overloading Mode
skills.desc: Auto. For 2 turns, basic attacks fire 5 shots (100% ATK each) and SPD +8%.

talents.name: Angel's Blessings
talents.desc: ATK +8% and Max HP +13%. A random ally gains the same at battle start.

skills.name: Thorns
skills.desc: Passive. DEF +21%. Deals 80% ATK Physical damage to each enemy that hits Hoshiguma.

skills.name: Saw of Strength
skills.desc: For 3 turns: ATK +95%, DEF +60%, and basic attacks hit up to 3 enemies.

talents.name: Tactical Armor
talents.desc: 28% chance to avoid damage from Physical and Arts hits.

skills.name: Power Strike γ
skills.desc: Auto. When ready, the basic attack deals 225% ATK.

skills.name: Rules of Survival
skills.desc: For 3 turns: DEF +65% and restores 12% max HP at the start of each turn.

skills.name: Truesilver Slash
skills.desc: For 3 turns: ATK +140%, DEF −70%, and basic attacks hit up to 5 enemies.

talents.name: Eagle Eyes
talents.desc: Can target Camouflaged enemies, and deals +20% damage to them.

skills.name: Pyroclasm
skills.desc: Auto. When ready, the basic attack deals 190% ATK Arts damage to all enemies, DEF −30% (1T), and builds Burn.

skills.name: Scorched Earth
skills.desc: For 3 turns: basic attacks deal 160% ATK and RES −10 (2T). Ifrit loses 4% max HP each turn.

talents.name: Rhine Loop
talents.desc: Every 2nd turn, Ifrit's skill cooldowns drop by 1 extra turn.

skills.name: Spirit Burst
skills.desc: Auto. For 3 turns, basic attacks fire 7 bolts (45% ATK each) at random enemies. Amiya is Stunned afterwards.

skills.name: Chimera
skills.desc: For 4 turns: ATK +160%, Max HP +75%, and basic attacks deal True damage. Amiya leaves the battle afterwards.

talents.name: Emotional Absorption
talents.desc: 30% chance after attacking, and always after a kill, to reduce Amiya's skill cooldowns by 1 turn.

skills.name: Charge γ
skills.desc: Auto. When ready, all allies gain 30% turn meter.

skills.name: Sword Rain
skills.desc: Deals 135% ATK Arts damage twice to all enemies and Stuns them (1T). All allies gain 30% turn meter.

talents.name: Tactical Delivery
talents.desc: All allies start battle with 8% turn meter.
